name: Zoya
msgs: I'm at the cafe. Where are you?
You said you were never late for me.
I'm outside. I'm just sitting in the car.
Because I'm scared daylight Ayaan is different from 3 AM Ayaan.
Come in. I'll tell you which one I like.
And if you don't like either?
closer: Fear parks outside for a minute. Love keeps the door open.
